reason: 该插件主要用于 DSH Web GUI 的会话回放与复现：提供本地会话时间线查看、回放包导入导出与一键重跑，并扩展为录屏后生成可复用技能的流程，核心目标是将已执行的交互转为可复用的工作流资产。该判断基于 README 与包信息中的双面插件能力与功能清单。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web GUI 插件，可记录与回放会话、导入/导出回放包，并支持录屏后生成可复用技能。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web GUI plugin for replaying recorded sessions, importing/exporting replay packs, and recording screen actions to generate reusable skills.

capabilities: Reads and processes local DSH session records
Displays session history as timeline with messages, tool calls, and results
Exports/imports replay packs in local JSON format
Replays/re-executes recorded user message sequences in a new session
Records browser screen/video and sampled frames locally
Generates SKILL.md content from frame analysis and installs it into local skills

reasons.code: Plugin documentation states it records screen/window via browser getDisplayMedia to webm with sampled frames and stores recordings locally, which can include sensitive on-screen content.
Feature list includes session timeline replay, replay-pack export/import, and one-click re-run of recorded user messages, indicating replay and automation-oriented behavior.
It writes data under ~/.dsh directories and exposes plugin routes for local web UI operations, showing local file and service interaction at host level.
